semantics.ticks: 1-based completed control transitions; window motion starts at its first transition BEFORE pose.
semantics.dp: A predicts same-transition q_after. Its disagreement here is on its own altered closed-loop state, not expert validation error. B predicts expert target u; autonomous actual q is not its expert label.
semantics.chain: raw plan -> joint-limited nominal -> reachable nominal anchor -> linear raw correction -> joint clip -> shared reachable projection -> issued/applied/actuator -> actual q.
semantics.direction: Opposition to nominal is a descriptive backend intervention, not a claim of wrong expert direction. No legal expert labels exist on these autonomous states.
semantics.rigid_attachment: Kinematic diagnostic: observed endpoint palm pose with the object-to-palm transform frozen at window start. Not a simulated intervention or predicted task outcome.
semantics.hold: Stable entries are endpoints of existing past12 diagnostic windows; leaving that set does not itself mean physical instability or a drop. Relative motion can be intentional in-hand manipulation, and a short-window worsening of goal angle can be an intermediate path. Actual native completion is authoritative; legal expert recovery actions are needed to evaluate policy direction.
semantics.window_motion: Motion intervals include the first transition BEFORE pose; this spans12 transitions. The existing stable-window rule uses12 AFTER poses (11 intervals), so first_stable_window motion can exceed its threshold without contradiction.
semantics.goal: All motion goal distances/angles use the window-start pre-action goal, including endpoints after a native goal switch; they are not distances/angles to the current endpoint goal. Before/after goal hashes and switch ticks are explicit. Native keypoint endpoints use their own actual transition targets and may refer to different goals.
semantics.angle: Normalized wxyz quaternion geodesic without shape symmetries; original native keypoint criteria remain authoritative.
semantics.limits: Observational decomposition cannot isolate causal effects, friction, contact-model error or visual state error; correlated changes do not prove a cause. Reused development starts are not independent test.

supersedes_report.reason: Explicit frozen window-start goal and per-transition native-goal semantics; goal transition admission.

semantic_revision_verification.verification: Every previously published case, chain-check and window scalar/array compared exactly. Source first transition has quaternion sign/roundoff changes with no native subgoal transition; these are separately identified. Only goal field names and new provenance/semantics differ.
